hypothesis: The abundance law N = b tau (layer 3, Little's law) holds for a nuclear decay chain (passive burner with P ~ F): in secular equilibrium N(234U)/N(238U) = T(234U)/T(238U). If so, the 234U half-life inferred from equilibrium abundances must equal one measured without assuming equilibrium. Path-A test in nuclear physics.

observable.domain: secular-equilibrium natural samples (Hu et al. 2025) and a direct determination (Varga et al. 2016)

fail_criterion: FAILED if z > 3; INCONCLUSIVE if 2 < z <= 3 or if the registered values disagree with the source texts.
note: Disclosure: drafted after reading both values (245,670 +/- 260 and 244,900 +/- 1340 yr); a hand estimate gives z near 0.6, so the outcome is effectively known. Secular equilibrium is textbook physics; the test checks that the UET abundance law carries over to nuclear decay. The direct value is taken as quoted by Hu et al. 2025.
